anchors.description: Width of the stainless built-in dishwasher front panel, left edge to right edge at mid-height
anchors.visible_evidence: Stainless appliance front under the counter immediately right of the sink base cabinet; full-height door with control strip at top, flanked by wood cabinets, width spanning the cabinet opening.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Assumed 24-inch dishwasher rather than 18-inch slimline or a 15-inch trash compactor; panel edges located to about +/-3 px.

anchors.description: Height of the same stainless dishwasher front, from the top edge under the counter down to the floor contact line
anchors.visible_evidence: Uninterrupted stainless front face from the shadow line under the counter down to where the panel meets the tile floor.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Same appliance identification assumption; upper few pixels may be concealed by the counter overhang so the visible height could slightly under-report 34 in.

anchors.description: Counter height above the dishwasher, from the countertop front edge down to the floor at the base of the same cabinet run
anchors.visible_evidence: Dark countertop front edge line above the dishwasher with a white bowl and glassware resting on the surface; tile floor visible directly beneath the same cabinet base.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Assumes a standard 36-inch base counter (not a raised bar); edge pixel and the floor point just in front of the toe kick carry about +/-4 px each.
